verdict.rationale: WorkOS ships a first-party product, Radar, described as protecting apps "from bots, fraud, and abuse" and priced as "Bot & Fraud Protection". That directly covers the bot part of the story. The evidence never names credential stuffing or brute-force defenses, and does not show how Radar hooks into the AuthKit sign-in flows. missing for 10: explicit credential-stuffing protection, brute-force/rate-limit or lockout behavior on auth flows, detailed Radar docs on how it works, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can rely on built-in protection against bots, credential stuffing, and brute-force attacks on the auth flows

citations.quote: Radar — Protect your app from bots, fraud, and abuse.
